answer: Attention Ridge Ledger. Each identity must post a small deposit that is refunded only after it has answered a random probe within a short window, delaying withdrawal. Probes arrive as a whisper at unpredictable intervals, so running N puppets demands N simultaneous watchers. The deposit is trivial; the real cost is sustained vigilance—operators must keep every identity responsive or forfeit principal. A jade marker tracks probe streaks, and identities that miss are frozen. Attacker burden scales with concurrent attention, not capital.
